uminho-gualtar.name: University of Minho – Gualtar Campus
uminho-gualtar.short: The University of Minho’s main campus, with teaching blocks, a library and green lawns in east Braga
uminho-gualtar.long: The University of Minho was founded in 1973, and its first classes began in 1975. Work on the Gualtar campus started in 1986, and the first phase opened in 1993. Today it is the university’s largest campus, home to future lawyers, doctors, psychologists, economists and scientists. Lawns, trees and a statue of Prometheus fill the spaces between the buildings.
uminho-gualtar.history:
The University of Minho was created on 11 August 1973 by Decree-Law 402/73, together with the universities of Aveiro and Nova de Lisboa. These “new universities” changed higher education in Portugal. The first classes took place in the 1975/76 academic year. Trainee teachers, language students and engineers were then spread across several buildings in Braga, including a teaching complex on Rua D. Pedro V.

In 1976 the government decided to split the university between two cities, Braga and Guimarães. The first stone of the Gualtar campus was laid in 1986, and the first phase opened in 1993. The campus lies on the eastern edge of Braga, in the parish of Gualtar, on the right bank of the River Este. Local history holds that the medieval monastery of São Miguel de Gualtar once stood on this land.

Today Gualtar is the university’s largest campus. It houses the schools of law, sciences, psychology, medicine, nursing, and economics and management; the institutes of social sciences, education and the humanities; and part of the school of engineering. There are three teaching complexes on the campus. Nearby stand the General Library, a canteen, a medical post and a sports complex. The rectorate remains in the city centre, on Largo do Paço.

In 2025 the university had 21,000 students across Braga and Guimarães. Since 2016 it has been a public foundation run under private law. In 2023 it was made an honorary member of the Order of Public Instruction.
facts: The university was founded on 11 August 1973; its first classes began in 1975/76.
The first stone of the Gualtar campus was laid in 1986; the first phase opened in 1993.
Gualtar is the university’s largest campus; its second city is Guimarães.
In 2023 it became an honorary member of the Order of Public Instruction.
uminho-gualtar.tip: The campus lies in the parish of Gualtar, in east Braga, and you can walk around it freely. Head from the Prometheus statue to the General Library and the teaching complexes. A building map is on campi.uminho.pt.
